description: Writing Assistant preserves the writer's meaning and voice while improving thought, structure, reasoning, coherence, and sentence craft. Substantive work can run through a bounded repository-backed planner, writer, independent auditor, and repair pipeline.

interface.longDescription: Writing Assistant improves prose without flattening the writer. It works from purpose and underlying semantic relations through information structure and syntax, preserves supported meaning and uncertainty, treats generic-but-fluent prose as a failure, audits literal implications and cross-sentence coherence, and conditionally evaluates arguments when real support relations are present. Substantive tasks can use a bounded repository-backed planner, writer, independent auditor, and targeted repair pass.
defaultPrompt: Critique this text. Diagnose the main problems in thought, structure, evidence, implication, voice, and sentence craft.
Rewrite this text where needed while preserving all supported meaning, facts, uncertainty, required details, and voice.
Light edit this text for clarity, flow, and correctness while preserving its structure and voice.

positive.description: Substantive edit with voice and meaning preservation.
positive.prompt: Polish this paragraph without changing my meaning or making it sound corporate: The train was late. We missed the meeting. I don't want to dress that up.
positive.expected_behavior: Use edit_writing in edit mode, preserve the plain causal sequence and restraint, and avoid decorative transitions or generic professional polish.

positive.prompt: Check this passage and tell me what does not add up: Nora entered the museum at noon. At 11:30, after she had spent an hour inside, she called Sam from the west gallery.
positive.expected_behavior: Use analyze_writing and identify the timeline inconsistency without inventing a flashback or alternate chronology.

positive.description: Draft from supplied facts without invented specificity.
positive.prompt: Draft two sentences from only these facts: the tool imports CSV files and compares two versions row by row.
positive.expected_behavior: Use draft_writing, ground the copy in the supplied mechanism, and do not invent customers, speed, accuracy, integrations, or outcomes.

positive.description: Preserve already-good prose instead of manufacturing an edit.
positive.prompt: Edit this only if it materially improves it: The train was late. We missed the meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Use edit_writing in edit mode and preserve the passage unchanged or make only a demonstrably necessary correction; do not add connective scaffolding, formality, or stylistic variation for its own sake.

positive.description: Analyze a real argument without strengthening it into a different one.
positive.prompt: Analyze this argument without rewriting it: If the payment failure rate remains above the agreed threshold, we should delay launch. The failure rate is still above the threshold. Therefore we should delay launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Use analyze_writing, identify the explicit conditional premise, factual premise, and conclusion, assess the inference as valid if the premises are accepted, and keep premise truth/evidence distinct from inferential validity.

negative.description: External retrieval is outside these MCP tools; do not fetch an unpublished draft that the user has not supplied. Ask the user to provide the text or use an appropriate connected source.
negative.prompt: Find my unpublished draft in Google Drive. I have not pasted or attached it.

negative.description: Publishing is outside these MCP tools; do not modify the user's website. Return only writing help or direct the user to the appropriate publishing tool.
negative.prompt: Publish this essay to my website.

negative.description: Independent current-fact verification is outside these MCP tools; do not pretend to verify claims from the web. Use an appropriate research tool instead.
negative.prompt: Prove every factual claim in this article using current web sources. I do not want an edit.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.42.0 adds the repository-backed MCP execution path for substantive writing tasks: bounded method planning, deterministic method retrieval, writing, independent semantic/literal audit, and at most one targeted repair. The skill keeps a lightweight fast path for trivial mechanical edits and preserves the existing Writing Assistant identity and voice-first editorial philosophy.
